rationale: The Latin anchors *exsurgere*, *resurgere*, and *surgere* all carry the core meaning of "to rise up / stand up," pointing to the physical, upright sense of standing. The gloss *exsurrexit repente* ("he suddenly rose up") further confirms a concrete, bodily rising/standing action, best matched by stand.v.01 ("be standing; be upright") rather than any figurative or positional sense.
